_comment: Template for the per-batch watchdog config. Copy it into your project, e.g.
The watchdog itself lives in the hpc-cluster skill: scripts/watch_jobs.ps1
Either put host_alias / remote_user here, or leave them out and let the
Nothing in this file is secret: it only says WHICH cluster alias to ssh to.
status_command is executed on the cluster via ssh and its output is pasted into
the final report - use it to print a per-system progress table.
status_command: cd /path/to/project/jobs && for d in */; do n=${d%/}; o=$(grep -c 'THE OPTIMIZATION HAS CONVERGED' $n/opt.out 2>/dev/null || echo 0); printf '%-30s converged=%s\n' $n $o; done
notes: patterns match the Slurm JOB NAME (squeue %j), not the job id
poll_seconds 300-900 is a good range: too small hammers the login node for nothing
